# ResearchPointRule

**Tags:** `world-system`

Points of research a player earns per source: a craft, a gathered resource, and a one-time bonus for the first craft of each recipe. Spent by beginResearch at the technology's researchCost.

> **Goal:** Make KnowledgeIsProgression cost something earned by play, not only materials and time
